paite: Huchi in i thugente lak a poimohpen hiai ahi; vanmun a Thupipen laltutphah taklam a va tu siampu lianpen neite i hi uhi.
heading: I Siampu Lian Jesu
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this. We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

paite: Amah mun siangthou leh biakbuk taktak, mihing lam hilou, Toupa lam zaw a nasempa i nei uhi.
english: a servant of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

paite: Siampu lian peuhmahte thilpiak leh kithoihnate lan ding a seh ahi ua; huchi in hiai siampu lianpen in banghiam bek lat ding neih akiphamoh hi.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

paite: Amah leitung a om lai hileh zaw, dan bang zel a thilpiakte lan ding om khinta ahih ziak un, siampu hilou ding ahi.
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;

paite: Amaute'n van lam thilte etsakna leh aliim in nna asem uhi. Mosi biakbuk lam dia akisak lai in Pathian hilh a om in, "Tang tung a etton ding ka hon etsak bang a biakbuk lam ding in pilvang in," achi hi.
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.” Exodus 25:40

paite: Tu in bel thuchiam hoihzaw tung a kinga thukhun hoihzaw a dia nasem palai ahih bang in, nasepna hoihzaw ana tangta hi.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

paite: Thukhun masa dembei na hileh, anihna hong om kul lou ding ahi.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

paite: Amaute dem in hiai thute agen hi, "Ngai in, nite ahong tung dek, Toupa'n achi, huai ni chiang in Israel inkuante leh Judah inkuante kiang ah thukhun thak ka bawl ding,"
heading: Thukhun Hoihzaw
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days come,” says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

paite: "Api-le-pute uh Aigupta gam a kipan pikhe ding a akhut ka let ni a akiang ua ka khun bang hilou in; ka thukhun ah a-om gige kei uhi, huchi in amau ka limsakta kei,” Toupa'n achi hi.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

paite: "Huai ni zoh chiang in Israel inkuante kiang a thu ka khun ding hiaite ahi, Toupa'n achi; alungsim uah ka thupiakte ka koih dia, alungtang uah ka gelh nalai dia, huan amau a ding in Pathian ka hi dia, kei a ding in amaute ka mite ahi ding uhi.
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel. After those days,” says the Lord; “I will put my laws into their mind, I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

paite: Huan michih in Toupa thei in, chi in ama inveng leh ama unau athuhilhta kei ding uhi; aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in avek un ahon thei chiat ding uhi.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen, TR reads “neighbor” instead of “fellow citizen” and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

paite: Atatleknate uah ka zahngai dia, akhelhnate uh leng ka theigige nawnta kei ding," chi in.
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.” Jeremiah 31:31-34

paite: Thukhun thak chi a agen ziak in amasa zat nawn louh ding in aluisakta hi. Huchi in aluita a, zat tak louh mang pah thei ahita hi.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant,” he has made the first old. But that which is becoming old and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
